items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Jap Allen is mentioned in a list of musicians ('Lee band, Jap Allen') but the interviewee does not describe a direct personal or professional interaction with him.

ctx.x: Another star in there was Booker Pitman, and I think he finally went across in Europe. Ben Webster, Joe Keyes, Jack Washington, and you see, during that time, (inaudible), Buster Smith out of Dallas and George and Julia

Lee band, Jap Allen, and so you see, whenever they played a dance--I never was participating in a jam session, but some of my men was always there, and I would be there looking to see what was happening, and you could get to see what was going on and make your choice and just see what was going on.

(Inaudible) Trent I think had one of the greatest bands that ever happened anywhere and he came into Tulsa, and that was one of my favorites. Of course he had that Snubs Mosley and the sliding saxophone, Lee Hilliard--
